description: Runs ONE analysis of ONE asset again — picture indexing or speech transcription — clearing whatever failure was recorded for it. If the asset already has a finished transcript or index, that result is deleted and rebuilt. Use when get_media shows phase 'failed' and the error looks worth another go, or when you want a fresh result for a file that changed meaning. Returns the project's analysis status.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.
